title: Native Primitive Humanoid
teaches: Build a complete stylized humanoid from 35 typed PrimitiveAsset instances without GLB or FBX.
Bind CompoundAsset instances to an existing space-3d Skeleton through canonical humanoid bones.
Reuse the landing page's standard walk, listening idle, wave greeting, and standard run Action code through selective ActionLibrary imports.
Separate detailed visual parts from one parent capsule and a solid static wall collider.
Keep every camera and animated limb on the visible side of the wall across a multi-camera 360-frame showcase.
